name: Auth:SecretHigh
desc: Secret key (high word) for access control

name: Auth:SecretLow
desc: Secret key (low word) for access control

name: Speed:Min
desc: Minimum motor speed; below this motor stops

name: AnalogInput:Stop
desc: AI voltage below which motor stops

name: Failsafe:Mode
desc: Mode used when RS-485 communication is lost

name: Failsafe:Delay
desc: RS-485 silence time before failsafe activates

name: Journal:Skip
desc: Skip first N records in journal query (0 = skip nothing)

name: Journal:Read
desc: Journal read trigger; each set bit selects an event type (0xFFFF = everything)

name: Fault:Reset
desc: soft: reinit interfaces; hard: reboot both MCUs; fcty: hard reset and wipe stored config

name: AnalogInput:SensValue
desc: Converted sensor value (AI mapped via SensMin/Max; type per Mode)

name: Flow:Value
desc: Estimated volumetric flow; soft sensor from speed and power

name: MeasSlow:Freq
desc: Electrical output frequency; slow tier = calm display trend

name: MeasSlow:Speed
desc: Speed computed from frequency and Motor:Poles

name: MeasFast:Freq
desc: Electrical output frequency; fast tier = protection-grade filtering

name: MeasFast:Speed
desc: Speed computed from frequency and Motor:Poles

name: MeasRaw:Freq
desc: Electrical output frequency; raw tier = latest unfiltered values

name: MeasRaw:Speed
desc: Speed computed from frequency and Motor:Poles

name: Speed:DerateTemp
desc: Temperature above which speed is derated down to Speed:Derating

name: Speed:DerateCurr
desc: Current above which speed is derated down to Speed:Derating

name: Thresh:CurrRms
desc: RMS current threshold for emergency shutdown

name: Thresh:CurrPeak
desc: Peak current threshold for emergency shutdown; amplitudes above 32.7A saturate the measurement

name: Thresh:PeakCount
desc: Peak overcurrent events tolerated before the fault trips

name: AnalogInput:Mode
desc: Analog input function (sens_u16/i16 raw type; flow overrides Flow LUT)

name: AnalogInput:SensMin
desc: Raw value at AnalogInput:Min voltage (type per Mode; no scale)

name: AnalogInput:SensMax
desc: Raw value at AnalogInput:Max voltage (type per Mode; no scale)

name: Fault:RetryDelay
desc: Extra delay after braking before auto-retry (min 1s enforced)

name: Fault:RetryTimeout
desc: Fault-free time to reset retry counter

name: Ctrl:BootDelay
desc: Stabilization delay after DC bus reaches Thresh:DcBusMin

name: Motor:Invert
desc: Swap phase sequence UVW to UWV; reverses rotation direction

name: Motor:Poles
desc: Pole pair count: rpm x poles / 60 = electrical Hz

name: Pwm:InitFreq
desc: Starting frequency for initial rotor alignment

name: Pwm:ClampShort
desc: Short-pulse suppression in PWM timer counts [0:off]

name: Ramp:StopFreq
desc: Reference frequency (x_max) for the Ramp curves

name: Ramp:UpdateN
desc: Frequency step every N PWM cycles

name: Ramp:RiseDeltaBend
desc: Bend for acceleration slew rate curve

name: Ramp:FallDeltaBend
desc: Bend for deceleration slew rate curve

name: Brake:TimeStop
desc: Coasting time before restart at maximum frequency

name: Brake:StartDelay
desc: Static-vector rotor alignment before acceleration begins; PWM holds a frozen phase so the rotor settles at a known angle

name: MeasCfg:Window
desc: Current and bus window length in samples; RMS/peak/ripple close once per window

name: MeasCfg:SchmittMin
desc: Zero-crossing hysteresis floor [ADC counts]; rejects idle noise

name: MeasCfg:SchmittDiv
desc: Zero-crossing hysteresis divider; threshold = window peak-to-peak / div

name: MeasCfg:HampelScale
desc: Global Hampel threshold multiplier [0:spike filter off]

name: MeasCfg:ScalarFast
desc: Fast tier EMA shift for voltages and temperatures; tau = 2^n samples at 10kHz

name: MeasCfg:ScalarSlow
desc: Slow tier EMA shift for voltages and temperatures

name: MeasCfg:WindowFast
desc: Fast tier EMA shift for currents/peaks/ripple; tau = 2^n windows

name: MeasCfg:WindowSlow
desc: Slow tier EMA shift for currents/peaks/ripple

name: MeasCfg:FreqReport
desc: Windows between frequency reports; one window is ~26ms

name: MeasCfg:FreqFast
desc: Fast tier EMA shift for frequency; tau = 2^n reports

name: MeasCfg:FreqSlow
desc: Slow tier EMA shift for frequency

name: Const:TempA
desc: Linear temp sensor slope: T = A × V_adc + B (linear sensor variant only)

name: Const:TempB
desc: Linear temp sensor offset: T = A × V_adc + B (linear sensor variant only)

name: Trim:CurrOffset
desc: Current zero offset; subtracted from RMS and peak publication

name: Trim:FreqScale
desc: Measured frequency scale correction; applied at Modbus publication

name: Trim:FreqOffset
desc: Measured frequency offset correction; skips a true zero

name: Stall:StopFreq
desc: Locked-rotor detection disabled above this frequency (also bend x_max) [0:off]

name: Stall:Bend
desc: Bend for stall current threshold curve

name: Freeze:VdcLow
desc: Freeze gate: acceleration freezes while DC-bus sits below this voltage

name: Freeze:VdcHigh
desc: Freeze gate: deceleration freezes while DC-bus sits above this voltage

name: Freeze:VdcHyst
desc: Freeze gate release hysteresis; both directions

name: Motor:Rs
desc: Stator phase resistance; 0 disables the observer (I/f only)

name: Motor:Lq
desc: Stator inductance Lq; LCR meter phase-to-phase /2

name: Motor:Ke
desc: Line-to-line RMS BEMF constant per mechanical krpm; 0 disables the observer

name: Motor:SenseMap
desc: Current-sense correction, latched at start: bit0 invert U, bit1 invert V, bit2 swap channels

name: Foc:Enable
desc: Vector control master switch; 0 keeps pure V/f rendering

name: Foc:StartCurr
desc: Current held through rotor align and the I/f ramp

name: Foc:StartFreq
desc: Observer takeover floor: forced angle below, closed loop above

name: Foc:IdRef
desc: Flux-axis current setpoint; 0 for a surface-magnet PMSM

name: Foc:IqMax
desc: Torque-axis current clamp; the entire current limit

name: Foc:ModCeil
desc: Voltage-vector ceiling; sampling slots stay valid to 90

name: Obs:LockErr
desc: Max observer-vs-forced angle error for takeover

name: Obs:DtComp
desc: Dead-time compensation strength; 100 cancels the nominal bridge loss

name: Obs:LockSpeed
desc: Max observer-vs-ramp speed error for takeover

name: Debug:FocState
desc: Vector-core state: below align = stop verdict (why V/f renders); align/forced/closed = live mode

name: Debug:IqCmd
desc: Torque command after clamp and regen fade

name: Debug:GuardVd
desc: vd the moment the start feed guard tripped

name: Debug:GuardId
desc: Measured id at guard trip: near 0 = blind channel, negative = inverted polarity

name: Debug:IsrSlack
desc: Minimum ISR tick slack over the last second

name: Debug:RegenCount
desc: Regen fade episodes since boot: braking met the bus ceiling

name: Debug:CeilCount
desc: Ramp holds since boot: past the takeover window or out of voltage authority

name: Debug:DutyPeak
desc: Peak PWM leg duty; attack instant decay about 10%/s

name: Debug:BusPeak
desc: Peak raw DC-bus; attack instant decay about 94V/s

name: Debug:BusMax
desc: Highest raw DC-bus since last start; held through a fault

name: Debug:RiseDelta
desc: Acceleration slew rate at current frequency

name: Debug:FallDelta
desc: Deceleration slew rate at current frequency

name: Debug:UpdateN
desc: Effective ramp update interval in PWM cycles

name: Debug:PeakCount
desc: Hardware peak events; drains while the comparator stays idle

name: Debug:FreezeRamp
desc: Why the ramp is frozen: bus too low to accelerate; too high to decelerate; I/f past its window or without voltage authority

name: Debug:LoadAngle
desc: Current vector angle vs the applied vector; atan2(Iq;Id)

name: Debug:FaultFreq
desc: Output frequency the moment the last fault tripped

name: Debug:FaultCurr
desc: Average current the moment the last fault tripped

name: Debug:FaultVdc
desc: DC-bus voltage the moment the last fault tripped

name: Debug:FaultTemp
desc: Power stage temperature the moment the last fault tripped

name: Debug:ThetaAvg
desc: Observer vs applied angle error; 1.3s mean for bias tuning

name: Debug:ObsErr
desc: Lock discriminant magnitude; 1.3s mean; takeover needs it under Obs:LockErr

name: Debug:ObsLock
desc: Takeover gate progress in detector ticks; fires at 40

name: Journal:Count
desc: Number of records returned by last Journal:Read (0..32)
